messages.author: Tomasz Wierzbicki
messages.text: Q3 2026 UA budget plan is up on Confluence for review. Headline: $5.10M paid for Jul-Sep, of which $4.95M is base plan (~$53.8k/day, +4% vs June run-rate) and $153k (3%) is a holdback. Split: Meta 32%, Google 24%, AppLovin 21%, TikTok 14%, Unity 10%. Guardrails: blended D7 ROAS >= 18% on mature cohorts, D30 ROAS >= 42%.

replies.author: Chloe Nguyen
replies.text: Numbers tie. Confirming the 3% holdback stays unallocated until September and is only released if ROAS guardrails hold.

replies.author: Marisol Okafor
replies.text: Approved, holdback as written. Tomasz owns the September release decision.
